tokens.typography: system UI sans-serif; tabular numerals for metrics; monospace only for fingerprints/raw evidence
tokens.elevation: restrained; borders + subtle shadow only for overlays and elevated panels

style.iconography: simple outline icons with consistent 1.5-2px stroke; never decorative when a text label is clearer
style.motion: short functional transitions only; honor reduced-motion preferences
style.imagery: no decorative stock imagery in core workflows; charts and evidence visuals must encode real data
style.voice_microcopy: concise, concrete, user-goal language; prefer 'Test a model' over internal evaluation terminology; errors state what failed and the next recovery action
